title: TriGraphQA: a triple graph learning framework for model quality assessment of protein complexes
one_liner_zh: 提出三图学习框架TriGraphQA，用于蛋白复合物模型质量评估，通过解耦单体与界面表征提升对接打分，虽非IDP对象但PPI界面建模方法可迁移启发。
abstract: Accurate quality assessment of predicted protein-protein complex structures remains a major challenge. Existing graph-based quality assessment methods often treat the entire complex as a homogeneous graph, which obscures the physical distinction between intra-chain folding stability and inter-chain binding specificity. In this study, we introduce TriGraphQA, a novel triple graph learning framework designed for model quality assessment of protein complexes. TriGraphQA explicitly decouples monomeric and interfacial representations by constructing three geometric views: two residue-node graphs capturing the local folding environments of individual chains, and a dedicated contact-node graph representing the binding interface. Crucially, we propose an interface context aggregation module to project context-rich embeddings from the monomers onto the interface, effectively fusing multi-scale structural features. We conducted comprehensive tests on several challenging benchmark datasets, including Dimer50, DBM55-AF2, and HAF2. The results show that TriGraphQA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-model methods. TriGraphQA consistently achieves the highest global scoring correlations and lower top-ranking losses. Consequently, TriGraphQA provides a powerful evaluation tool for protein-protein docking, facilitating the reliable identification of near-native assemblies in large-scale structural modeling and molecular recognition studies.
abstract_zh: 预测蛋白质-蛋白质复合物结构的准确质量评估仍是一项重大挑战。现有的基于图的质量评估方法通常将整个复合物视为同质图，这掩盖了链内折叠稳定性与链间结合特异性之间的物理差异。在本研究中，我们引入了TriGraphQA，一种新颖的三重图学习框架，专为蛋白质复合物的模型质量评估而设计。TriGraphQA通过构建三个几何视图，明确解耦单体表示和界面表示：两个残基节点图捕捉各链的局部折叠环境，以及一个专门的接触节点图代表结合界面。关键的是，我们提出了一种界面上下文聚合模块，将来自单体的富含上下文的嵌入投影到界面上，有效融合多尺度结构特征。我们在多个具有挑战性的基准数据集上进行了全面测试，包括Dimer50、DBM55-AF2和HAF2。结果表明，TriGraphQA显著优于最先进的单模型方法。TriGraphQA始终实现最高的全局评分相关性和更低的顶级排名损失。因此，TriGraphQA为蛋白质-蛋白质对接提供了强大的评估工具，有助于在大规模结构建模和分子识别研究中可靠识别近天然组装体。
